integrity: Mathematical proof plus reproducible finite diagnostics; no independent audit or empirical validation. Earlier published asymptotic constant explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Local background-dominated Fisher D-optimality for two Poisson aggregate counts within a fixed circular field, centered known Gaussian PSF and strictly positive uniform sky intensity; excludes finite-flux optimization, robust inference, stochastic sky gradients and full-resolution imaging. Large-field 1.5852 sigma constant already established in classical SNR literature.
title: Unique optimal two-region Gaussian photometry under a fixed readout budget
